description: Fidelity suite corpus. 'expect': 'pass' means zero oracle differences; 'baseline' means compare against tools/fidelity/baselines/<name>.<stage>.json and fail only if a count rises. knownFailing marks a stage as expected to fail (reported XFAIL).

mods.name: created-thornvale
mods.description: Made from scratch in the editor: a nation, its units, weapons, armor, capital site and pretenders. Every line regenerated on the round trip.

mods.name: created-ashwolves
mods.description: Made from scratch in the editor: a summoned monster, the ritual that summons it, a magic item. Every line regenerated on the round trip.

mods.name: created-hermit
mods.description: Made from scratch in the editor: an event chain with a player choice and a delayed follow-up. Every line regenerated on the round trip.

mods.name: created-firespear
mods.description: Made in the editor: a balance tweak of vanilla units, a weapon and a spell (an inherited weapon replaced, an ability and a flag removed). Every line regenerated on the round trip.

mods.name: created-freecompanies
mods.description: Made from scratch in the editor: two mercenary bands (one from a game band) and a poptype. Every line regenerated on the round trip.

knownFailing.1: oracle limit: the inspector's export (export-mod.js) leaves out the mod's #selectevent of a game event (#selectevent 5 #rarity 2), so the reload has the game's rarity (-2)

mods.name: domenhanced-2.13-regen
mods.description: Every line regenerated (Dom5Tests roundtrip regen), still in file order: tests the export itself, which saving unedited lines as read would hide (docs/SAVE_FLOW.md).

stress.description: Stage 5 (tools/fidelity/stress.mjs): 'size' generated edits per mod in one session, seeded (--seed N for another run): exactly their expected changes, then undo all / redo all byte for byte. A mod whose file doesn't exist is skipped.

merges.name: merge-events
merges.title: Merge test: events
merges.about: two mods' events on the same code, variable, enchantment and monster tag: the later one's move

merges.name: merge-sequence
merges.title: Merge test: sequences
merges.about: a hydra (#shrinkhp/#growhp), an #xpshape line and a ritual summoning its unit and the next (effect 10141) colliding in the middle move as blocks; #xpshapemon; a template follows its nation and #form

merges.name: merge-copies
merges.title: Merge test: copies
merges.about: copies of a game unit, spell (by number, by name, a copy taken out by a later one), site and item an earlier part changes copy the game's (snapshots; a spell's school, a site's rarity and an item's construction level put back after the copy); a copy of a tagged item (Dragon Pearl: the game hands it out at any level) isn't kept apart, noted; a copied summon's #damage follows its unit's move

merges.name: merge-slots
merges.title: Merge test: numbers the game gives
merges.about: #newspell/#newitem take no number (the first free one from 1500/700, #newitem 800 too): a later part's numbered spell and items on those move; its own unnumbered item, pushed up by the earlier part's, would land on its numbered 704, which moves too; its 800 stays (A's #newitem 800 isn't 800)

merges.name: merge-spells
merges.title: Merge test: spell damage
merges.about: a spell's #damage moves with its target only where the game reads a monster, tag, enchantment, event #id or site (the exe's table: tools/dom6exe spelleffects); 10089/10114 keys 1-99, bitmasks (web, false fetters), ability numbers stay

merges.name: merge-confluence-bloodwar
merges.title: Confluence + Bloodwar
merges.about: two nation mods, 53 collisions; dead lines (a later #copyitem), a text without its closing quote, a file without its last line break

merges.name: merge-sombre-pack
merges.title: Sombre pack
merges.about: a submod read over its parent (keeps its numbers, its replacement of the parent's 14118), a third mod moving around both

merges.name: merge-fr-domenhanced
merges.title: FR + DomEnhanced
merges.about: the hardest pair: 1,087 collisions, unit chains, copies of game units the other changes, dangling references

renumbersAbout: Stage 6 too (docs/RENUMBER.md): Dom5Tests renumber moves the mod's own numbers to blocks from 'starts' (gameNumbers: its own on the game's numbers too), saves as the editor saves (it must read back the same), and undo/redo must save byte for byte; then gameread.py --merge reads the renumbered file as a one-part merge (the numbers mapped through the moves): no differences, no chained unit out of order. A mod that isn't installed skips the case; slow ones run only in the full suite.

renumbers.name: renumber-fixture
renumbers.about: names written with their number, a #select by name, a run of units that turn into the next (kept together), a lone #shrinkhp (kept where it is), a line of two commands, a merc's "Name (number)", a template's #form, events

renumbers.name: renumber-fixture-overlap
